location.en: Your studio apartment, phone call with Brightway
location.zh: 你的套房，與 Brightway 通電話

goal.en: Get through a phone screening and set up an interview time.
goal.zh: 通過電話初步篩選，並約好面試時間。

background: small studio apartment with a single bed, a desk with a laptop and a coffee mug, a bookshelf with plain spines, a window over a quiet street, morning light

intro.en: Two days after you apply online, your phone rings. It's a Maple Bay number you don't know.
intro.zh: 上網應徵兩天後，你的手機響了。是一個不認識的楓灣號碼。

intro.en: You turn down the music and pick up.
intro.zh: 你把音樂關小，接起電話。

lines.en: Hi, this is Rachel from Brightway. Is this Kai? Do you have a few minutes to talk?
lines.zh: 嗨，我是 Brightway 的瑞秋。請問是凱嗎？你現在方便講幾分鐘嗎？

choices.en: Yes, this is Kai. I have empty now.

lines.en: You have... empty? Empty what? Is everything okay?
lines.zh: 你有……空的？什麼空的？一切都還好嗎？

story.en: Rachel thinks your fridge is empty and asks if you need help. It takes two minutes to explain that you're just free.
story.zh: 瑞秋以為你冰箱空了，還問你需不需要幫忙。你花了兩分鐘才解釋清楚，你只是「有空」。

fail.why: 「我有空」直譯成 I have empty，英文聽不懂。說 I'm free now. 或 Yes, now is a good time.。

choices.en: Yes, this is Kai. Now is a good time. Thanks for calling!
choices.zh: 是，我是凱。現在方便，謝謝你打來！
choices.tip: 接到招募電話，先確認身分，再說 Now is a good time.，最後道謝。

choices.en: Brightway? Finally! I've been waiting for two whole days.

lines.en: Two days is actually pretty quick for us, but okay.
lines.zh: 兩天對我們來說其實算很快了，不過好吧。

story.en: Rachel's voice cools down a few degrees. She makes a quick note: 'Patience: needs work.'
story.zh: 瑞秋的語氣降了好幾度。她快速記下一筆：「耐心：有待加強」。

fail.why: 抱怨對方回覆太慢，聽起來像在責怪招募人員。接到電話時表達感謝就好：Thanks for calling!。

lines.en: Great. Just a few quick questions. First, are you legally allowed to work in Maple Bay?
lines.zh: 好的，只是幾個簡單的問題。首先，你可以在楓灣合法工作嗎？

choices.en: No worries. I can take cash, so no paperwork needed.
choices.zh: 別擔心，我可以領現金，不用跑什麼文件。

lines.en: Cash? No, we only hire people who can work legally. Everything here is on the books.
lines.zh: 現金？不，我們只錄用可以合法工作的人，這裡一切都照規定來。

story.en: The call gets very quiet. Rachel thanks you for your time a little too quickly.
story.zh: 電話那頭突然安靜下來。瑞秋謝謝你撥空的語氣，快得有點不尋常。

fail.why: 被問能否合法工作時回「可以領現金」，聽起來像要打黑工，正規公司會立刻扣分。直接說明身分：I have a working holiday visa with a work permit.。

choices.en: Yes, I am allow to work here until next year.
choices.zh: 可以，我被允許在這裡工作到明年。

lines.en: Sorry, you are allow...? So, are you allowed to work or not?
lines.zh: 抱歉，你是 allow……？所以你可以工作還是不行？

story.en: Rachel asks you to email a copy of your visa, just to be sure. Then she asks again. And again.
story.zh: 為了保險起見，瑞秋請你把簽證影本寄給她。然後又問了一次。再一次。

fail.why: 「被允許」是被動語態，要用過去分詞：I'm allowed to work here.。更清楚的說法是 I have a working holiday visa with a work permit.。

choices.en: Yes, I have a working holiday visa with a work permit.
choices.zh: 可以，我有打工度假簽證和工作許可。
choices.tip: 被問工作資格時，直接說出簽證種類：I have a... visa with a work permit.。

lines.en: Perfect. And when would you be available to start?
lines.zh: 太好了。那你什麼時候可以開始上班？

choices.en: I'm available from next month, after my course ends.
choices.zh: 我下個月可以開始，那時課程就結束了。
choices.tip: I'm available from + 時間，清楚說出可以開始的日期。

choices.en: I'm available on next month, any day is okay.
choices.zh: 我下個月可以，哪一天都行。

lines.en: On next month? Do you mean any day next month, or a specific day?
lines.zh: On next month？你是說下個月任何一天，還是特定某天？

story.en: Rachel isn't sure when you can start, so she writes a big question mark next to your name.
story.zh: 瑞秋搞不清楚你哪天能上班，只好在你的名字旁畫了一個大問號。

fail.why: next month、next Monday 前面不加 in 或 on。要說 I'm available from next month. 或 I can start next Monday.。

choices.en: I'm free every day. I just watch dramas at home, haha.
choices.zh: 我每天都有空，就在家追劇而已，哈哈。

lines.en: Ha... okay. So you could start right away?
lines.zh: 哈……好喔。所以你馬上就能開始？

story.en: Rachel types 'available, loves dramas' into her notes. Not quite the first impression you were going for.
story.zh: 瑞秋在筆記裡打上「隨時可上班，熱愛追劇」。這不太是你想留下的第一印象。

fail.why: 被問何時能上班，給出具體時間就好，不用說在家追劇這種和工作無關的事：I'm available from next month.。

lines.en: Great. Our manager, Ms. Wong, would like to meet you in person. When would be a good time for you?
lines.zh: 好的。我們的王經理想跟你當面談談。你什麼時間比較方便？

choices.en: Any weekday afternoon works. What time suits Ms. Wong?
choices.zh: 平日下午都可以。王經理什麼時間方便？
choices.tip: 先給一個時間範圍，再反問對方 What time suits you?，雙方都好安排。

choices.en: Could Ms. Wong come to my place instead? It's easier for me.
choices.zh: 王經理可以改來我家嗎？這樣對我比較方便。

lines.en: To your... apartment? Um, interviews are at our office, Kai.
lines.zh: 到你的……公寓？呃，凱，面試是在我們公司。

story.en: Rachel laughs, but you can tell she will be telling this story at lunch for weeks.
story.zh: 瑞秋笑了出來，但你知道接下來幾個禮拜，她午餐時都會拿這件事當話題。

fail.why: 面試是你去對方公司，要求面試官配合你的方便很失禮。給出你方便的時段，再問 What time suits Ms. Wong?。

choices.en: Up to you. I can cooperate with any time.
choices.zh: 看你們，我什麼時間都可以配合。

lines.en: Cooperate? Ha, it's not a group project. Just tell me a day that works.
lines.zh: 合作？哈，這又不是分組報告。告訴我哪天可以就好。

story.en: Rachel picks 8 a.m. on Saturday. It turns out 'any time' really does mean any time.
story.zh: 瑞秋選了星期六早上八點。原來「什麼時間都可以」真的就是什麼時間都可以。

fail.why: 「配合」直譯成 cooperate 很奇怪，cooperate 是「合作」。說 I'm flexible. 或直接給時間：Any weekday afternoon works.。

lines.en: Let's do Thursday at 2 p.m. at our office on Harbor Street. Any questions before then?
lines.zh: 那就約星期四下午兩點，在我們港灣街的辦公室。在那之前有什麼問題嗎？

choices.en: What is Ms. Wong like? Is she married?
choices.zh: 王經理是怎樣的人？她結婚了嗎？

lines.en: That's... not something I can share. See you on Thursday.
lines.zh: 那個……我不方便透露。星期四見。

story.en: Rachel ends the call very quickly. You wonder if she will tell Ms. Wong about your question.
story.zh: 瑞秋很快就掛了電話。你開始擔心她會不會把你的問題告訴王經理。

fail.why: 在台灣問「結婚了沒」很常見，但在這裡打聽別人的婚姻狀況很失禮，何況是面試官。可以問和面試有關的事：Should I bring anything?。

choices.en: Thursday 2 p.m. is okay. I will be arrive on time.
choices.zh: 星期四下午兩點可以，我會準時到。

lines.en: You will be... arrive? Okay, I'll take that as a yes!
lines.zh: 你會是……抵達？好吧，我就當你說好了！

story.en: Rachel hangs up before giving you the street number. On Thursday, you walk up and down Harbor Street for twenty minutes.
story.zh: 瑞秋還沒給門牌號碼就掛了。星期四那天，你在港灣街來回走了二十分鐘。

fail.why: will 後面直接接原形動詞：I'll arrive on time. 或 I'll be there on time.。也別忘了確認細節：Could you email me the details?。

choices.en: Could you email me the details? And should I bring anything?
choices.zh: 可以把細節寄信給我嗎？我需要帶什麼東西嗎？
choices.tip: 面試前請對方寄細節、問要帶什麼，顯示你做事仔細。

lines.en: Sure, I'll email you right now. Just bring a copy of your resume. See you Thursday!
lines.zh: 沒問題，我現在就寄給你。帶一份履歷就好。星期四見！

lines.en: A minute later, the email arrives. You add the interview to your calendar and do a small happy dance.
lines.zh: 一分鐘後，信就到了。你把面試加進行事曆，開心地跳了一小段舞。

story.en: One short phone call, and you have a real interview at a real company. Now you just need to prepare.
story.zh: 一通簡短的電話，你就在真正的公司拿到了真正的面試。接下來只需要好好準備。

notes.explain: 接到電話被問 Do you have a few minutes? 時的回答。不方便就說 Could I call you back in ten minutes?。

example.en: Sorry, I'm on the bus. Could I call you back in ten minutes?
example.zh: 抱歉，我在公車上。我十分鐘後回撥給你可以嗎？

notes.zh: 我從……開始有空／可以上班。
notes.explain: 說明可以開始上班的時間。next month、next Monday 前面不加 in 或 on。

example.zh: 我從下週一開始可以上班。

notes.zh: 工作許可／打工度假簽證
notes.explain: 被問 Are you legally allowed to work here? 時，直接說出簽證種類。be allowed to 是被動，要用 allowed。

example.en: I'm allowed to work here for one year.
example.zh: 我可以在這裡合法工作一年。

notes.explain: 「我有空」不能說 I have empty；「我可以配合」不能說 I can cooperate，cooperate 是「合作」。

example.en: I'm flexible. Any weekday afternoon works for me.
example.zh: 我時間有彈性，平日下午都可以。

notes.en: When would be a good time for you?
notes.explain: 約時間時先給出你方便的時段，再禮貌地問對方。電話面試中只問和工作有關的事，不要打聽面試官的私生活。

example.en: Tuesday or Wednesday works for me. When would be a good time for you?
example.zh: 星期二或星期三我都可以，你什麼時候方便？
